data.narrative:
Axibo AI is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised C$12M to date. The comparable universe consists of one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers in the robotics and manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The robotics and manufacturing sector contains only eight private comparables overall, but when filtered for same-stage companies, only one datapoint emerges. No adjacent-stage or similar-tier peers exist in sufficient quantity to meet the minimum threshold of three comparable firms required for robust triangulation. An all-sector median would introduce significant distortion given the heterogeneity of robotics subsectors and development timelines.

Without a sufficient narrow peer set, traditional multiple-based triangulation cannot be reliably executed. Valuation of Axibo AI would require alternative approaches such as venture capital method analysis, detailed management scenario modeling, or qualitative assessment against the broader peer cohort without relying on statistical medians. The primary uncertainty remains the absence of adequate same-stage comparables to establish quantitative benchmarks for seed-stage robotics companies. Any valuation conclusion must acknowledge this methodological constraint.
